cc_review_corrections: Different legacy top-level labels do not establish different underlying corpus versions: Dolma3 wrappers reuse Dolma1.7 wiki and the same FineMath3plus cache.
A single observed proxy-to-target shift is not a mathematical lower bound.
No measured TinyLlama/Llama3 corpus token-count conversion factor is established in this package.
A matched-minus-unmatched contrast changes available unique data and subset composition as well as repetition.
A common primary objective should be preserved; a secondary shared exclusion set avoids changing objectives separately for each domain.
